Final hold (about 5.0–8.0s): the elephant sways its trunk and the warrior waves his sword; the glyph is still. Narration: one gentle off-screen voice, Taiwan standard Mandarin, speaks only this line and nothing else, each syllable clear with its tone: 鼻、鼻、鼻孔（ㄅㄧˊ、ㄅㄧˊ、ㄅㄧˊ ㄎㄨㄥˇ）. The glyph 鼻 fills roughly 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped, and stays perfectly still for the final 3 seconds while the lead keeps playing away from the strokes. No real people, no flashing.
